author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.95 shipped: No false 'Envoy write reverted' page at the nightly Envoy drop
summary: No false 'Envoy write reverted' page at the nightly Envoy drop
why: Four false CRITICAL 'Envoy write reverted' pages in 8 days, all at the nightly ~23:05 Envoy drop: the local Envoy had confirmed the commanded reserve at 21:00, then went unavailable and the verifier fell back to a stale cloud value. The card's original rule would have hidden the real 10-24 page because the landed stamp is set at send time, so the fix remembers the local witness itself and qualifies only while the cloud is unchanged, which also survives restarts.
implications: Shipped EC-ENPHASE-CONNECTIVITY-RESILIENCE-1 at v5.103.95; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.95.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a false REVERTED page fires at the nightly drop with reserve_witness_confirm set, if a real revert goes unpaged, or if the Envoy upstream per-endpoint isolation fix lands.

refs.release_notes: Remember the local Envoy's confirmation of the commanded reserve and the cloud value at that moment; skip the REVERTED page only while local is unavailable and the cloud still shows that value. Real reverts still page. Tier 3, reviews A-D, orchestrator mutation, name-diff clean.
